cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:3d4.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Sales Associateat Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this role, you’ll support daily operations, deliver a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and help drive sales by sharing product knowledge. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Actively engage customers, identify their needs, recommend relevant products or experiences, and leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture Sales & Business Performance · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Promote add-on sales and support events that grow store traffic and customer engagement. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Collaborate with team members to maintain a positive, inclusive, and high-performing store culture · Support onboarding of new associates by sharing product knowledge and best practices Operations & Compliance · Accurately and efficiently process transactions including sales, returns, and price checks using the POS system. · Assist in daily opening and closing procedures, floor replenishment, and maintaining visual merchandising standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work · Available to work between 12 and 16 hours per week, with a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. While this is the minimum availability, scheduled hours may differ based on business needs. · Regular and predictable attendance Qualifications & Experience · Must be 18 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year of retail sales experience preferred. · Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. · Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences. · Proficiency in Microsoft Office and retail management syst

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:7743bc07-.description: ABOUT GEN: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. ENGINE BY GEN Engine by GEN helps enterprise partners distribute, monetize, and optimize financial product experiences across digital channels. Engine powers marketplace, recommendation, API, and embedded product experiences that connect consumers with relevant financial products, services, and offers. We are building the platform infrastructure that allows financial products to be distributed intelligently across many partners, tenants, channels, and user experiences. That requires more than adding features. It requires scalable systems for APIs, product catalogs, offer management, attribution, reporting, configuration, experimentation, compliance workflows, and operational tooling. ABOUT THE ROLE Engine by GEN is looking for a Director of Product to own the product strategy and roadmap for the core platform capabilities that power our B2B2C financial product marketplace. This is a senior, hands-on product leadership role for someone who can operate at both the strategic and technical levels. You will define how Engine’s platform supports enterprise partners, API integrations, hosted experiences, multi-tenant configuration, backend event tracking, funnel measurement, and scalable operations. The right person will be able to translate complex partner needs, business goals, technical constraints, and operational requirements into platform capabilities that are reusable, measurable, and maintainable. You will be expected to make thoughtful tradeoffs between flexibility and simplicity, partner customization and platform standardization, near-term revenue and long-term scalability. You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Sales, Partner Success, Analytics, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership to prioritize high-impact platform investments and ship products that improve how Engine scales. WHAT YOU’LL OWN · The roadmap for Engine’s core platform capabilities, including APIs, backend services, tenant configuration, product catalogs, offer management, routing logic, eligibility rules, capping, reporting, attribution, and event tracking. · Platform features that allow Engine to support many partners and tenants without creating one-off implementations for every customer. · API and hosted experience infrastructure that enables consistent measurement across partner-controlled and platform-controlled user journeys. · Backend event models that help Engine understand funnel starts, completions, abandonment, conversion, revenue events, partner performance, and product outcomes. · Internal tools and workflows that improve partner onboarding, configuration manage

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7f69bc62-66ae-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Cloud Delivery Architect based in Netherlands. This is a senior, hands-on cloud architecture role focused on delivering complex Google Cloud engagements from design through implementation and handover. You will take ownership of scoped, fixed-budget projects and translate customer requirements into reliable production environments. The role combines cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, and DevOps expertise. You will work directly with customers, lead technical discussions, and manage several engagements in parallel. You’ll also drive cloud migrations, establish secure landing zones, and modernize infrastructure through automation and GitOps. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on enterprise cloud transformation while operating with significant technical and delivery ownership. Own the end-to-end delivery of Google Cloud engagements, from low-level design and implementation through validation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and final handover. Design and execute cloud migrations from AWS or Azure to Google Cloud, including production workloads such as EKS to GKE, RDS to Cloud SQL, and S3 to Cloud Storage. Design and implement secure Google Cloud foundations and landing zones covering resource hierarchies, IAM, organization policies, networking, and security controls, with infrastructure codified in Terraform. Architect and deploy production-grade GKE environments, including private clusters, node pools, Workload Identity, Helm-based add-ons, ingress, autoscaling, and Cloud Armor. Enable DevOps and infrastructure automation by importing existing environments into Terraform, developing reusable modules, and implementing CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions and Argo CD. Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, maintaining delivery plans, project hours, scope, budgets, and timelines while identifying risks and budget deviations early. Lead customer-facing workshops, weekly meetings, technical discussions, and handover sessions with engineering teams, technical leaders, and CTO-level stakeholders. Protect project scope through effective change management and ensure that all delivered environments are supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer. Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully in architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment and quality standards. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and architecture experience, with deep production experience specifically in Google Cloud. Strong expertise in Terraform, including reusable and modular infrastructure code, remote state management, and importing manually provisioned environments. Proven production experience with Kubernetes and GKE, including private clusters, node pools, autoscaling, RBAC, Workload Identity, Helm, and ingress. Strong knowledge of Google Cloud networking and security, including VPC architecture, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPN, Private Service Connect, firewall policies, IAM, Organization Policies, and Secret Manager. Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions or equivalent, keyless authentication to Google Cloud, container workflows, and GitOps with Argo CD or similar tools. Working knowledge of AWS or Azure, with the ability to understand and assess source-cloud environments as part of migration projects. Strong customer-facing English communication skills, with confidence leading technical workshops, weekly meetings, presentations, and handovers. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical engagements, work within defined budgets and scopes, and take ownership of delivery outcomes.
